_comment: F3: LLM-generated band/sub-band names (claude-fable-5; core set 2026-07-29, extended set 2026-07-30). Committed so the viewer stays deterministic. Entries are keyed by keyword signature: `sig` = first 3 TF-IDF keywords joined with '|', `sig5` = first 5 (used when 3-word signatures collide). The viewer applies a name only when the signature still matches, so stale entries fall back to raw keywords. One file serves both the core and extended datasets.
